subject.title: refactor: remove pre-2026.4 compatibility shims and legacy migrations

question: Should direct pre-2026.4 Matrix upgrades remain supported, or may the next release require a manual 2026.6 stepping-stone installation?
rationale: The PR changes a released persistent-state upgrade contract and introduces operator action that current update flows neither enforce nor perform.

options.title: Preserve direct upgrades
options.body: Retain the doctor migration or add an updater preflight that migrates or blocks before installing the incompatible release.

options.title: Require intermediate release
options.body: Accept the cutoff and add a visible pre-update block with exact intermediate-version and recovery instructions.

recommendation.title: Preserve direct upgrades
recommendation.body: Retain the doctor migration or add an updater preflight that migrates or blocks before installing the incompatible release.

likelyOwner.reason: They defined the proposed support boundary and authored the cross-area cleanup scope.
